speaker: james_burbage
text: Both cloaks. He said you said both. The king is done.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I hear you, Master Burbage. I do not hear a price.

speaker: james_burbage
text: Six fingers is not a price. A dry room is not a price. I was told there is nothing to speak of. I am speaking of it by standing in the yard.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then we have both stood. What I said of the neighbours was said this morning, to your son. I am not making it a verdict here.

speaker: james_burbage
text: I did not ask you for a verdict. I am not ready to hear a sum in my own mouth, and I will not have you put one there.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then none will be put. The cloaks did the errand. I am for home.
